title: No. 10 and pandemic-data personnel diaspora: Samantha Jones intake

selection.selection_unit: One named person who held a declared 2019-2022 No. 10, Cabinet Office, DHSC, NHS data, health, operations, or pandemic-response role and one later source-explicit private appointment or commission.
selection.selection_basis: The row was opened from the official ACOBA/Civil Service Commission record identified in issue #31. It is a positive anchor for exercising the case schema, not a source-neutral cohort selection.
selection.denominator_description: The complete 2019-2022 public-side cohort and matched comparator officials have not been enumerated before destination searching.
selection.target_removal_test: The case remains coherent without Electric Twin, but this single person cannot establish a diaspora rate or a recurring pathway.
selection.privacy_boundary: Public-role and public business-appointment records only; no private contact, family, residential, or sensitive personal data.
promotion_blockers: the repository receipts are structured official-source extracts rather than complete remote-page snapshots
one row cannot establish prevalence, recurrence, or a rate

sources.title: Jones, Samantha - Expert Adviser and Interim Permanent Secretary and Chief Operating Officer at No.10 and DHSC - ACOBA Advice
Advice Letter: Samantha Jones, commission with CeraCare under her independent consultancy
Correspondence: Gisela Stuart, First Civil Service Commissioner, to Sam Harrison, 18 June 2026

observations.factual_statement: The official business-appointment record identifies Samantha Jones as Expert Adviser on Health to the Prime Minister from April 2021, later Expert Adviser and Interim Permanent Secretary and Chief Operating Officer at No. 10, and an Expert Adviser at DHSC for seven weeks in November and December 2022.
objects: Department of Health and Social Care
observations.allowed_language: The official record documents the named public roles and their approximate windows.
forbidden_inferences: The public roles prove prior planning for later private work.
Service at No. 10 or DHSC proves influence over any later client.
The row establishes a diaspora rate or recurring state-to-market pathway.

observations.factual_statement: The ACOBA record documents a proposed and subsequently advised paid commission with CeraCare under Jones's independent consultancy after she left Crown service.
observations.allowed_language: A paid post-government commission with CeraCare is documented.
forbidden_inferences: The commission was a reward for official decisions.
The commission proves contract steering, privileged access, or coordination.
CeraCare hired Jones because of government influence rather than prior healthcare expertise.

observations.factual_statement: ACOBA imposed conditions covering privileged information, lobbying, government bids and contracts, use of official contacts, and advance advice for later consultancy commissions for two years after Crown service.
observations.allowed_language: The official regulator identified risks and imposed mitigation conditions; advice was not an endorsement.
forbidden_inferences: Restrictions prove that a prohibited act occurred.
Regulatory review validates the commercial appointment or its merits.

observations.factual_statement: The same ACOBA record states that Cera's two DHSC recruitment-platform contracts ran from April to October 2020 before Jones joined government, that she was not involved in them, that she did not meet CeraCare or make decisions specifically affecting it, and that there was no evidence the later role was a reward for official actions. It also records a healthcare career exceeding thirty years before government service.
objects: Department of Health and Social Care
observations.allowed_language: The official record contains source-explicit counterevidence and an ordinary prior-expertise explanation that must accompany the transition row.
forbidden_inferences: The absence of evidence in this decision proves that no undisclosed relationship could exist.
Prior healthcare expertise proves the later commission had no value from government experience.
A documented transition alone establishes influence or reward.

observations.factual_statement: The ACOBA record states that during Jones's final seven-week DHSC role she was formally recused from AI-related matters while considering future roles in that field; the role focused on winter pressures.
objects: Department of Health and Social Care
observations.allowed_language: A formal recusal from AI-related matters is documented for the final DHSC stint.
forbidden_inferences: The recusal proves no AI-related contact or knowledge existed outside the recused role.
The recusal itself establishes misconduct or conflict.

observations.factual_statement: On 18 June 2026 the Civil Service Commission recorded one consolidated Business Appointment Rules breach concerning management of later consultancy work: work with Carnall Farrar before final advice and work with Newmarket, Huma, and System C without prior advice. The letter also records constructive and transparent engagement, proactive disclosure of several matters, the explanation that omissions were accidental, and no evidence that the substantive conditions were not followed.
observations.allowed_language: A later consolidated procedural breach is officially recorded for four other consultancy matters and must be represented with the Commission's mitigating and non-substantive findings.
forbidden_inferences: The later consolidated breach retroactively proves impropriety in the CeraCare commission.
A failure to obtain prior advice proves lobbying, contract steering, misuse of information, or deliberate misconduct.
The breach may be merged with the CeraCare appointment as if it concerned the same client or event.

case_disposition.machine_summary: One official-to-private transition row now has immutable repository source extracts and is accompanied by official restrictions, ordinary explanations, counterevidence, recusal, and a separate later compliance breach. Human review and the neutral cohort denominator remain incomplete, so the row stays intake and cannot establish a diaspora pattern.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A bounded case-intake packet preserving one official transition row, counterevidence, regulatory conditions, immutable structured source extracts, and a later separate compliance record.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A frozen cohort, a diaspora rate, a finding of influence, reward, steering, coordination, wrongdoing, a full remote-page archive, or a promoted thesis evidence packet.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: One receipted post-government appointment cannot establish a state-to-market diaspora. The same official record contains substantial ordinary explanations and counterevidence, and the 2026 procedural breach concerns separate consultancy matters and cannot be used retroactively to characterize the CeraCare commission.
